segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Welcome to Greenfield High School. The library is on your left, next to the science building. It opens at eight thirty on weekdays.

segments.speaker: Student
segments.text: Our English club meets every Wednesday after class. This week, we are preparing a short radio play about life in the future.

segments.speaker: Teacher
segments.text: Please remember to bring your notebook to Room 204 before the workshop begins at two fifteen.
